subtitle: Different metrics measure different kinds of "wrong."

steps.label: MAE: average absolute error
steps.sub: Every dollar of error counts equally

steps.label: RMSE: sqrt of average SQUARED error
steps.sub: Big misses count far more than small ones

steps.label: R²: share of variation explained
steps.sub: 1.0 perfect, 0 = no better than the mean, can go negative

steps.label: MAPE: average % error
steps.sub: Easy to explain -- but blows up near zero
